entries.en: Thanks for your help, Commander. I didn't think I was going to make it.
Gunnery Chief Ashley Williams of the 212. You the one in charge here, sir?
A few scrapes and burns. Nothing serious. The others weren't so lucky.
Oh, man.... We were patrolling the perimeter when the attack hit.
We tried to double back to the beacon. But we walked into an ambush.
I don't think any of the others.... I think I'm the only one left.
Yes, sir. We held our position as long as we could. Until the geth overwhelmed us.
I think they're geth.
We held our position as long as we could. The geth overwhelmed us!
The dig site is close. Just over that rise. It might still be there.
Aye, aye, sir. It's time for payback.
Let me come with you, sir. The geth slaughtered my unit. Give me a chance to get even!
She knows the area, Commander. And we could use the extra firepower.
Understood, Commander. You give the orders and I'll follow 'em.
They were doing some digging out here to extend the monorail and expand the colony. A few weeks ago they unearthed some Prothean ruins... and the beacon.
I don't know much about the beacon itself. But I heard one of the researchers say this could be the biggest scientific discovery of the century.
We were sent out a couple nights ago from the main colony to secure the area.
Seemed like a routine patrol until the geth hit us. We never knew they were coming.
I don't know. They set up camp near the beacon. The 232 was with them. Maybe their unit fared better than mine.
There aren't any turians on Eden Prime. None that I've ever met. Not sure I'd be able to tell if one was a Spectre, anyway.
If you saw this guy, you'd know. Carries enough firepower to wipe out a whole platoon. Luckily, he's on our side.
Sorry. Like I said, no turians.
Are you wounded, Williams?
Give me a status report, Williams.
This isn't your fault, Williams. You couldn't have done anything to save them.
Any idea what kind of enemy we're facing?
You just left the rest of your unit behind to die?
We could use your help, Williams.
You're coming with us, Williams. We need that beacon.
Lieutenant Alenko and I will take care of this.
Welcome aboard, Williams.
Just don't forget who's in charge.
Tell me everything you know about the beacon.
Describe what happened leading up to the attack.
What happened to the researchers at the dig site?
Have you seen a turian Spectre around here?
Move out!
Are you okay?
What happened here?
Don't blame yourself.
Fighting these things?
You abandoned them.
Join us.
Take us there.
Stay here.
Okay.
Fine, come with us.
Beacon
Before the attack
Nihlus
Let's go.
And the scientists?
We tried to get off a distress call, but they cut off our communications. I've been fighting for my life ever since.
The geth haven't been seen outside the Veil in nearly 200 years. Why are they here now?
They must have come for the beacon.
I need a status report. Now.
Where's the rest of your squad?
We're on a mission.
What happened to your unit?
What killed them?
Suddenly, every scientific expert in the colony was interested. That's when they brought us in to secure the site.
Staff Lieutenant Kaidan Alenko. Glad to have you on the team.
Just what I remember from history class back in school. They're synthetics. Non-organic life-forms with limited AI programming created by the quarians a few centuries ago.
They were supposed to be a source of cheap labor, but ended up turning on the quarians and drove them into exile.
After that, they just kind of disappeared behind the Perseus Veil. Nobody's really heard much from them since.
What else do you know about the geth?
Good idea.
Geth
Gunnery Chief Ashley Williams of the 212. You the one in charge here, ma'am?
Yes, ma'am. We held our position as long as we could. Until the geth overwhelmed us.
Let me come with you, ma'am. The geth slaughtered my unit. Give me a chance to get even!
Aye, aye, ma'am. It's time for payback.
The beacon's at the far end of this trench.
Looks like the geth beat us to it.
Then I guess we better take it back!
